title: Boeing 707 roll by Test Pilot Tex Johnson
summary: Footage of Boeing test pilot Tex Johnson barrel-rolling the Boeing 707 prototype over Lake Washington, followed by his explanation of the stunt.
why: HN cites it as a famous bit of aviation history showing the roll was a gentle 1G maneuver and salesmanship.

quote.text: What were you doing Tex? I was selling airplanes.
